subject: server.R can't find helper function after moving App directory

messages.author: 81bb9891cf94337a
messages.subject: server.R can't find helper function after moving App directory
parts:
After developing and testing a simple app that uses a function in helpers.R, I moved the App directory to a location for use with github. After moving the app, I get an error when running it: "can't find function raiseCompare"

Is there some path reference that I need to change when moving an App? The project is available on github, perhaps someone else can check it out and see if they have the same error.
https://github.com/bmorrisey/SalaryComparison

Thanks!

messages.author: 81bb9891cf94337a
messages.subject: Re: server.R can't find helper function after moving App directory
parts:
I fixed the problem by adding 
source("helpers.R")
to server.R. Still not sure why the app worked without this line before the move, but everything seems to be working at this point.
